title: AGLC licensing for alcohol manufacture and sale
plain_language_summary: Alberta uses a privatized liquor distribution model, producers still need a licence from the AGLC and must go through a registered private liquor agency to reach retail.
raw_requirement_text: A manufacturer or agency must hold a valid licence from the Alberta Gaming, Liquor and Cannabis Commission prior to the sale or distribution of liquor in Alberta.

title: Federal meat inspection for interprovincial sale
plain_language_summary: Same federal requirement nationwide: meat crossing a provincial line needs CFIA inspection regardless of provincial-only certification.
raw_requirement_text: Meat products moved in interprovincial trade require inspection under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations administered by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency.

title: National Safety Code (NSC) carrier profile, Alberta
plain_language_summary: Commercial carriers need an Alberta-registered NSC carrier profile and safety fitness certificate before operating.
raw_requirement_text: Operators of commercial vehicles based in or operating within Alberta must maintain a National Safety Code carrier profile under Alberta's Traffic Safety Act.

title: Alberta regulatory body registration
plain_language_summary: Regulated professions require registration with the applicable Alberta regulator; Alberta has been an early mover on internal trade legislation, so recognition of comparable credentials tends to be more streamlined than average.
raw_requirement_text: Individuals practising a regulated profession in Alberta must register with the applicable Alberta regulatory body, subject to recognition provisions under Alberta's internal trade legislation.
authority: Relevant Alberta regulatory college (varies by profession)
